releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.96 restores multi-select in Files > Search. Tap Select (or long-press a result), choose two or more search results, then use Add to Category once to assign the whole selection to the same category. The selection path is shared by all Search result types, so it works for Documents (PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), Photos/Images and Videos. The existing one-file folder-plus action remains available outside selection mode, and file opening, thumbnails, filters and indexing remain unchanged.
